thread:
Marina (Partnerships): AcmeEdge asked if we can include per-seat changes in the marketplace usage webhook so they can prorate mid-cycle. They want a single stream instead of separate adjustments. Risk: double-billing. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Sam (Integrations Eng): We only accept usage_units + sku_id today. We can add seat_snapshot/seat_delta but need strict idempotency.

Nina (Billing): We need an entitlement_sequence per customer. Proposal: require seat_snapshot (absolute int) + entitlement_sequence (monotonic int). If sequence <= last_applied_sequence ignore. This preserves idempotency and lets billing compute prorates.

Alex (SRE): Also add replay/backfill endpoint and rate limits for entitlement events. Instrument a metric partner.entitlement.sequence.skew to detect gaps.

Jordan (Partner Success): AcmeEdge can emit entitlement_sequence and idempotency_key. They want credits applied immediately to avoid customer confusion.

Sam (Integrations Eng): We'll draft webhook v2 with seat_snapshot + entitlement_sequence + idempotency_key and return an ack with last_applied_sequence.

Nina (Billing): Billing will compute prorate adjustments in cents using banker's rounding and apply to current open invoice if within cutoff, otherwise queue for next invoice. I'll draft RFC and loop in Legal.

billing-bot: Created ticket INV-3421 for "Entitlement sequence + prorate support" and linked to this thread. :white_check_mark:

Marina (Partnerships): Aim: partner beta by end of next sprint to align with AcmeEdge announcement. I'll follow up with sample payloads.
